gloss: The letter u standing for the word you, as text messages write it.
The letter r standing for the word are, as text messages write it.
The letter y standing for the word why, as text messages write it.
The letter k standing for the word okay, as text messages write it.
The letter f standing for the expletive, as in wtf; a crude term.
The digit 2 standing for the word to, as text messages write it.
The digit 4 standing for the word for, as text messages write it.
The digit 8 standing for the word ate, as text messages write it.
The digit 1 standing for the word won, as text messages write it.
